en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a path running through dense vineyard-style vegetation, with trellised plants or vines on both sides. In the center stand four men in light colonial-era clothing and hats, two of them with bicycles. In the background are tall metal tower structures, possibly windmills or water towers. At the top of the image there is printed text identifying the scene as the entrance to 'Quinta Thomaz Ferreira' in Benguella.
